'''Max Salven''' won the [[1997 Kiffex Regionals]]. He published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs and posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list.

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I come from Finland, and currently live in England. I will be 15 next January, making me one of the younger qualifiers. I am a major Star Wars fan, collecting everything, not just the card game. I originaly just collected it, but then I tried playing it, and from there I got involved with the listserv, and eventually got pretty good at the game. As for other hobbies beside Star Wars, well.umm.er.not much else really. My favorite movies are, surprise surprise, the Star Wars trilogy. I am very excited about the World Championships, and I think I might use an all-Jawa Deck;-)."

"If anyone wants to contact me, you can view my Web Site at http://hot.virtual-pc.com/mufty/swccg/intro.html (Star Wars CCG-related, of course =), and for any of you Palace people, I am at most of the conferences, using the 'Mufty' handle. Not much else to say, except I'd like to say 'Good Luck!' to all of the other qualifiers, and I look forward to meeting the Decipher Crew! Best Regards, Max Salven."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/salven.html Max Salven], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428091822/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/salven.html Internet Archive]</ref>
